entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's a piece of junk.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the order number?
The name is Mark Sterling. Order number is VF98752. This thing is completely broken and I want my money back. Now.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse. I'm sorry you're having trouble with it. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
What kind of stupid question is that? It's not working! It won't sync with my phone, the screen keeps freezing... it's defective! I'm not paying for a broken product.

I completely understand your frustration. A band that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Thank you for clarifying that it's a technical fault. Let me just check the delivery date... I see it was delivered 18 days ago.

I don't care if I got it 18 days ago or 18 minutes ago! It's defective! Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will light up your company on every review site on the internet.

I understand, and I want to get this resolved for you. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we definitely value your business. For a defective device after the first 10 days, our standard procedure is to connect you with our specialized technical support team. They are equipped to diagnose the issue and can authorize a warranty replacement immediately if they can't fix it.
I don't want to talk to another person! I want a refund, not a replacement for your broken garbage. This is ridiculous. Just take it back!

I can definitely appreciate not wanting to be passed around. The reason for the transfer is that our tech team has advanced tools to confirm the hardware fault. They are the only department authorized to approve a full refund if the device is confirmed as non-repairable. I can do a warm transfer for you right now, which means I'll get them on the line, explain the entire situation, and you won't have to wait in a queue or repeat yourself.
So I don't have to wait on hold again? You're sure?

Yes, I guarantee it. And for the inconvenience this has caused, I'd also like to add a $50 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase. We want to make this right.
Fine. A $50 credit and no waiting. Transfer me. But if they give me any trouble, I'm calling back, and I will be speaking to a manager.
Understood. I've added the credit and the notes to your account right now. Please hold for one moment while I connect you directly to a senior technician. Thank you for your patience, Mark.
